summary: The Courses card header and 'Add course' button underwent unexpected color changes from blue/light to gray/dark, which does not match the design intent of updating card text.

regressions.explanation: The background color of the card header changed from primary blue (rgb(13, 110, 253)) to gray (rgb(108, 117, 125)), which is unintended as the design intent only specified updating text.
The 'Add course' button background color changed to dark (rgb(33, 37, 41)) with white text, altering the button styling unexpectedly.
